purpose: Teach: 乗り出し/幾何/高揚/恣意/乖離/排他/占拠/屈辱

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、新治療法に乗り出した医療チームの取り組みをお伝えします
lines.en: Ren, I want to tell you about the new treatment approach our medical team is undertaking.
lines.style: Clear, professional opening. Steady eye contact. Warm but measured — this is important information being delivered by someone who has delivered it many times before.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、医療画像の幾何学的解析を医療チームで進めます
lines.en: Yes — we're advancing geometric analysis of medical imaging as a team.
lines.style: Even tone, unhurried. A slight pause before the explanation, like she's choosing her words carefully for clarity. Confident but not rushed.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 回復期の患者さんの高揚感を、貴院、慎重にケアされてますね、先生
lines.en: You notice how carefully your hospital handles the hope that comes with recovery, don't you, Doctor?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, almost wondering aloud. Respectful but not deferential. Soft pace, seeking confirmation of something he's observed.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、診断の恣意性を防ぐ仕組みを医療チームで強化します
lines.en: Yes — we're reinforcing our systems to prevent bias in diagnosis across the entire team.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact commitment. Light emphasis on 'reinforce.' Calm delivery that suggests this is ongoing work, not a finished solution.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 検査結果と症状の乖離を、貴院、丁寧にご説明されますね、先生
lines.en: And when test results don't match what patients are feeling, your hospital takes real time to explain that gap, doesn't it?
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost reflective. Not a question expecting a quick answer. Slight warmth — he's expressing something he respects about her practice.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、排他的な医療体制を医療チームで改めます
lines.en: Yes — we're working to reshape our medical systems so they're truly inclusive for everyone.
lines.style: Quiet resolve underlying the words. Not defensive, but firm. The clarity of someone who has thought about this deeply.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 避難所が占拠された場合の医療支援を、貴院、想定されてますね、先生
lines.en: Even for emergency shelters, if they're overwhelmed — your hospital already plans for how to support people medically, I imagine?
lines.style: Gentle question, carefully framed. Not testing her — genuinely wondering. Respectful pace, the tone of someone thinking through a difficult scenario out loud.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、患者さんの屈辱感を癒すメンタルケアを医療チームで重視します
lines.en: Yes — our team prioritizes mental care that heals the shame and indignity patients sometimes carry.
lines.style: Close, intimate tone despite clinical content. Words land softly. The emphasis on 'heal' carries genuine compassion underneath the professional delivery.
